content: Prior work in this direction has largely focused on post-hoc identification of various kinds of antisocial behavior, including hate speech BIBREF3, BIBREF4, harassment BIBREF5, personal attacks BIBREF6, and general toxicity BIBREF7. The fact that these approaches only identify antisocial content after the fact limits their practicality as tools for assisting pre-emptive moderation in conversational domains.
